One commit on the branch above base e8f2b9ca6, containing the kernel change and the pool edit together per repo convention. Not pushed, no PR, nothing amended.

Working tree after the commit holds only untracked .osdk/, which is the cargo-osdk build artifact this run's osdk_bin in state.json points at. Global git config was not modified. Note that make format and make check are themselves immune -- the Makefile passes --git-dir=$PWD/.git to git for exactly this reason, per its own comments at lines 428 and 446.

Commit message content, mapped to its sources: root cause is diagnose.json's stub description; the invariant paragraph is diagnose.json's invariant, with linux_reference's ipcperms() cited as the reason the exclusive triplet selection is correct rather than as the justification on its own; the enforcement paragraph is fix.json's layer, stating both where the predicate lives and why not SemaphoreSet or the sys_sem* handlers, so a reviewer can judge the placement; the corrected-call-sites and left-unchanged paragraphs come from fix.json's generalizes, since semop's empty request and semget's hardcoded ALTER|READ are changes a reviewer would otherwise read as unrelated scope creep. gvisor_filter is null, so no case-subset note was needed.
